verses.text: Ach in Diosal, swal wach' lolonel t'ayach, manh ach b'at mikan t'a in lesal.
Yujto a heb' sk'ulan chukal yet' heb' tz'ak'an musansatil anima, chuk syal heb' t'a in patik. Esnhej tas syal heb' chi' t'a in patik.
Ha schichonk'olal heb' ste oymaj t'a in patik. Tz'och chi'an sk'ol heb' t'ayin, palta malaj in mul t'a heb'.
Ha spak in wach'k'olal t'a heb', to tz'och heb' ajk'olal t'ayin. Ha inxo jun, wan in lesalwi yuj heb'.
Ha in wach' pensaril t'a heb', chuk syutej heb' spaktzitan t'ayin. Haxo spak in wach'k'olal t'a heb', to schichon sk'ol heb' t'ayin.
Ha junok winh chuk spensar tzak'och juezal t'a yib'anh winh. Aokab' junok yajk'o'ol winh tz'ak'ankanb'at t'a yib'anh.
Ayik sch'olb'itaj winh, alchajokab'i to ay smul winh. Ochokab' pax slesal winh smulok.
Tzapanokab' tzutej sk'inal winh. Ch'okokab' pax mach tz'ochkan t'a yopisio winh.
Mheb'a' uninokab' tz'ajkan heb' yuninal winh. Haxo ix yetb'eyum winh, kanokab' ix t'a manh etb'eyumal.
Ek'okab' heb' yuninal winh sk'an wa sb'a t'a titak pat. Pechchajokab'el heb' b'aj ek'nak spat.
Ik'chajokab' ek' masanil tastak ay t'a heb' yuj winh tz'ak'an tumin majanil. Ik'chajokab'b'at smunlajel winh yuj heb' ch'ok anima'il.
Malajokab' mach tz'ok' sk'o'ol t'a winh. Malajokab' pax mach tz'ok' sk'ol t'a heb' yuninal winh mheb'axo.
Satokab'el yinhtilal winh, satokab'el sb'i winh t'a junelnhej.
Mamin Jehová, nakot smul heb' smam yicham winh. Mokab' a suk sat smul snun winh.
Na'anokab' smul heb' u'uj. Mokxob' nachajkot heb' t'a sat lu'um tik.
Yujto manh na'anok yak'an wach'k'olal winh. Palta to ix och winh ajk'olal t'a heb' meb'a', t'a heb' anima emnakil yek'i yet' t'a heb' ayoch t'a ilk'olal, masanto smilcham heb' winh.
Skatab'ej anima winh, kotokab' katab' t'a yib'anh winh. Malajokab' b'ak'inh scha wach'k'olal winh yujto maj yak'laj swach'k'olal winh t'a heb' anima chi'.
Haxonhej katab' syal winh, ichato a katab' chi' spichul winh yaji. Ha katab' chi', icha ha' sikil ha' skuk'ej, ma icha aceite sko sukek' t'ayonh, icha chi' yaj t'a winh.
Kotokab' yahelal t'a yib'anh sniwanil winh yuj skatab'an heb' anima chi', icha smuschaj ko niwanil yet' ko pichul. Ochokab'kan sut'an yahelal chi' t'a winh t'a masanil tiempo icha junok tzek'ul.
Mamin Jehová, ichaokab' tik tzutej heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'ayin, haton heb' tz'alan in pekal.
Ha hachxo pax ach Jehová Wajalil, ak'kot a wach'k'olal t'a wib'anh yik ol ach ik'jokcha'anh. Yuj a wach'k'olal t'ayin, kolineli.
Te meb'a' in, manhxo anima'ok wet'nak swutej wab'ani, icha wal to lajwinak in swab'i.
Wan in satel icha junok enhul. Wan wik'jib'at yuj ik' ichok nok' k'ulub'.
Wan yib'xi sjolom in penek, manhxalaj wip yujto maxtzak in walaj. Wan in b'akb'i.
Tzheb'ajtak wilji t'a heb' anima. Ayik tzin yilan heb', sb'uchwaj heb' t'ayin.
Mamin Jehová, ochanh wet'ok. Ach in Diosal, kolinel yuj a wach'k'olal.
Mamin Jehová, yojtakejokab'el heb' anima to a ach ix in utej icha tik.
Malaj yelk'och in skatab'an heb' tato a ach tzak'kot a wach'k'olal t'ayin. K'ixwokab' heb' yakb'an wan stzalaj in k'ol a in a chekab' in tik.
Ha heb' tz'alan in pekal, chamokab' heb' yuj k'ixwelal. Toxonhejokab' sat sk'ol heb' yuj k'ixwelal.
Mamin Jehová, ol wak' yuj diosal t'ayach t'a masanil tiempo. T'a skal tzijtumal anima ol wal wach' lolonel t'ayach ach in Diosal,
yujto Yalumal heb' meb'a' aji. Ha ach tza kolel heb' t'a yol sk'ab' heb' snib'ej yak'anoch chamel t'a yib'anh heb'.
